title: Hosted Rollouts (Canary) GA — E2E Test Plan (Staging + Pre-GA)
body:
Owner: Leila Farouk (QA Automation)
Last review requested from: Dylan (Console), Mina/Ravi (Routing), Logan (Telemetry), Sean/Allison (SRE)

Purpose
- Define end-to-end (E2E) scenarios required for GA of Hosted canary rollout workflow.
- Cover Console workflow + control-plane policy validation + data-plane routing behavior + telemetry + audit logging.
- Provide seed data requirements and repeatable staging runs (CI + manual smoke).

Scope
IN SCOPE
1) Console workflow E2E: create/edit rollout, schedule steps, guardrails, preview effective routing, pause/rollback, activity/audit timeline.
2) Control-plane integration: policy schema v2 persistence, deterministic evaluation, entitlements/RBAC checks, safe defaults.
3) Data-plane routing: weighted splits for Hosted routes, optional stickiness, streaming/session semantics (pin variant at request start; retry stability).
4) Telemetry: per-variant metrics (baseline/candidate) and compare views; verify tags and cardinality boundaries.
5) GA operational: propagation checks across regions, rollback speed/semantics, audit events emitted, SLO/alert sanity.

OUT OF SCOPE (explicit)
- Model quality evaluation correctness (we will only validate wiring of optional quality gates if enabled).
- Performance benchmarking (handled by runtime perf suite; here only functional correctness + basic latency sanity).
- Dedicated/Private rollouts.

Test Environments
Primary
- Staging control plane + staging Console + staging Hosted routing/data plane.
- Regions: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-central-1 (minimum for propagation tests).

Secondary
- “Pre-prod” / canary internal environment (if available) for last-mile release smoke.

Feature flags / config
- hosted_rollouts_ga_enabled: ON for test tenant(s) only.
- rollout_preview_endpoint_enabled: ON.
- telemetry_variant_tags_enabled: ON.
- stickiness_enabled: ON (when testing sticky mode).

Test Tenants + Seed Data
We need stable, reusable seed data so tests can be rerun without manual cleanup.

Tenants
- tenant_consoleqa_admin (plan: Enterprise / GA-enabled)
- tenant_consoleqa_readonly (plan: Enterprise / GA-enabled, role: ReadOnly)
- tenant_consoleqa_noga (plan: Standard / NOT entitled)

Roles / users
- user_admin@consoleqa.redwood (role: OrgAdmin; can create/edit/pause/rollback)
- user_deployer@consoleqa.redwood (role: Deployer; can create/edit/pause but NOT manage RBAC)
- user_viewer@consoleqa.redwood (role: Viewer; read-only)

Routes
- route: /v1/chat/completions (staging) alias: chat-completions-consoleqa
- route: /v1/embeddings (staging) alias: embeddings-consoleqa (used for “non-streaming” baseline route)

Models/versions (staging catalog)
- baseline model: llama-3.1-8b-instruct (version pinned: v2024-10-01)
- candidate model: llama-3.1-8b-instruct (version pinned: v2024-10-15) OR a compatible variant with known behavior delta
Notes:
- Keep architecture compatible for fallback and routing validation.
- For negative tests, include an intentionally incompatible candidate (e.g., embeddings-only model for chat route) to verify validation.

Traffic generator
- “canary-e2e” load script that can:
  - send both streaming + non-streaming chat requests
  - attach deterministic header for stickiness tests (e.g., X-Redwood-Session-Id)
  - emit request IDs for later metric lookup

Data cleanup strategy
- Prefer idempotent test setup:
  - Use deterministic rollout names, and “upsert” or delete-if-exists via API.
  - Keep a single active rollout per route per tenant.
- If hard deletes are risky, suffix with date and run cleanup nightly.

Test Tooling / Execution
Automation
- Playwright (preferred) for Console UI flows (wizard, validation, history timeline).
- API-level checks via a small test client (Go/Node) to:
  - create/pause/rollback rollouts quickly
  - query preview/effective routing
  - hit Hosted inference endpoints at volume
- Metrics assertions via:
  - metrics query API (if exposed) OR internal dashboard snapshot endpoints
  - fallback: log-based assertions in staging with known labels

CI hooks
- Nightly staging E2E suite: runs full flow + propagation + telemetry tags.
- PR-gated smoke suite for Console changes: wizard create + pause + rollback only (kept under 10 min).

Test Cases (E2E Scenarios)
Legend
- P0: must pass for GA signoff
- P1: strongly desired; can be waived with documented risk
- P2: post-GA hardening

A. Console Wizard + Policy Creation
A1 (P0) Create rollout — minimal safe config
Steps
1) Login as OrgAdmin on tenant_consoleqa_admin.
2) Navigate: Hosted Routes -> chat-completions-consoleqa -> Rollouts -> Create.
3) Select baseline (model+version pinned) and candidate (model+version pinned).
4) Set initial split: 95/5 (baseline/candidate).
5) Leave default guardrails ON (latency + error rate); keep safe defaults.
6) Save.
Assertions
- API returns success; rollout appears in list with status “Active”.
- Preview effective routing shows baseline=95, candidate=5 with correct model IDs/versions.
- A “rollout.create” audit event exists with before/after payload.

A2 (P0) Validation — percent sum constraints
- Attempt to set weights that do not sum to 100.
- Expect inline validation error; save disabled.

A3 (P0) Validation — guardrails required when candidate > X%
- Set candidate to 50% and attempt to disable all guardrails.
- Expect blocking validation OR permission-gated override.
- Confirm error message is actionable (mentions which guardrail is required).

A4 (P1) Manual step schedule
- Configure steps: 5% -> 25% -> 50% (manual advance).
- Save.
- Assert schedule persisted and UI indicates “awaiting step advancement” state.

A5 (P1) Timed progression
- Configure timed steps with short durations in staging (e.g., 2 min) if supported.
- Verify progression occurs and audit events reflect step changes.
Note: if timed progression uses a background worker, verify worker is enabled in staging and doesn’t conflict with other tests.

A6 (P0) Edit rollout — safe update
- Edit existing rollout to change 95/5 to 90/10.
- Assert:
  - idempotency (repeat edit request does not duplicate history)
  - audit event “rollout.update” with diff
  - preview shows updated effective routing

B. RBAC / Entitlements / Error Handling
B1 (P0) Entitlement gate
- Login to tenant_consoleqa_noga.
- Navigate to Rollouts page.
- Expect: feature unavailable state + clear CTA (contact support / upgrade), no create button.

B2 (P0) RBAC — Viewer cannot create/edit
- Login as user_viewer@consoleqa.redwood.
- Attempt to create rollout.
- Expect: action disabled + permission error copy (non-500).

B3 (P1) RBAC — Deployer can pause/rollback but cannot change RBAC
- Validate allowed actions align with permissions spec.
- Confirm API returns 403 with structured error for UI.

C. Data-Plane Routing Correctness
C1 (P0) Weighted split distribution (non-sticky)
Setup
- Rollout weights: 90/10.
- Stickiness: OFF.
Execution
- Send 2,000 non-streaming requests with randomized prompts.
Assertions
- Observed candidate selection rate approximates 10% within tolerance (e.g., 8–12%).
- No request returns mixed-variant responses.

C2 (P0) Stickiness mode — stable assignment by session
Setup
- Enable stickiness for route (per rollout config if available).
Execution
- Use 200 unique session IDs.
- For each session ID, send 20 requests.
Assertions
- Each session ID consistently routes to the same variant across requests.
- Aggregate distribution still respects 90/10 across session IDs (within tolerance).

C3 (P0) Streaming pinning — variant pinned at stream start
Setup
- Streaming requests enabled.
Execution
- Start 50 streaming chat requests.
- For a subset, force a retry mid-stream (simulate client disconnect + retry with same request id/session id, per supported semantics).
Assertions
- Retry lands on same variant as original selection.
- No cross-variant mixing within a single stream.
References: streaming semantics PR / ADR.

C4 (P1) Route-level overrides vs account-level defaults
- If layered policies exist, configure an account-level rollout default and override at route-level.
- Preview endpoint must clearly reflect effective routing.
- Confirm data plane uses effective routing (not raw policy object).

D. Propagation + Staleness + Regional Behavior
D1 (P0) Policy propagation latency
- After create/edit, measure time until all target regions apply new weights.
- Method:
  - Poll preview endpoint (control-plane) for version.
  - Send region-pinned requests (if supported) and compare variant distribution.
- Acceptance (staging): within configured SLO thresholds (exact numbers in SLO doc; record measured values).

D2 (P0) Stale region detection
- Inject failure: block propagation to eu-central-1 (simulate by disabling subscriber/agent or network rule if safe).
- Edit rollout weights.
- Assertions
  - Control plane surfaces degraded propagation status somewhere (Console banner or internal status API).
  - Data plane in blocked region continues using previous version.
  - Audit/log entry indicates propagation issue.

D3 (P1) Monotonic version application
- Rapidly edit weights 3 times (90/10 -> 80/20 -> 70/30) within < 1 minute.
- Assert all regions converge to latest version (70/30), and do not “roll back” to older weight versions.

E. Guardrails + Auto Actions
NOTE: exact behavior depends on final GA decisions. If auto-pause/auto-rollback exists, include it; if not, validate alerting + manual actions.

E1 (P0) Guardrail configuration persists + displayed correctly
- Configure thresholds:
  - error_rate_delta_max
  - p95_latency_delta_max
  - token_cost_delta_max (if available)
- Save and reload page.
- Assert values persist and are reflected in preview/effective policy.

E2 (P1) Guardrail breach simulation (error rate)
- Induce candidate 5xx by routing candidate to a canary backend that returns deterministic failures OR by injecting a fault flag.
- Generate traffic.
- Assertions
  - telemetry shows candidate error rate spike
  - UI compare view highlights delta
  - if auto-pause enabled: rollout pauses and emits audit event
  - if manual-only: ensure runbook steps work and UI supports quick pause

E3 (P1) Guardrail breach simulation (latency)
- Introduce artificial latency on candidate path.
- Same assertions as E2.

F. Pause / Rollback / Resume Semantics
F1 (P0) Pause rollout — candidate forced to 0%
- Trigger pause from Console.
- Assertions
  - effective routing becomes 100/0 (baseline/candidate) OR candidate disabled, per product spec
  - in-flight streaming requests do not break (no mid-stream variant switching)
  - audit event “rollout.pause” with actor

F2 (P0) Rollback to baseline
- Trigger rollback from Console.
- Assertions
  - candidate removed from effective policy (or weights 100/0 with “Rolled back” state)
  - history timeline shows rollback action
  - data plane honors rollback in all regions within SLO

F3 (P1) Resume after pause
- Resume rollout; ensure returns to prior weights and schedule step.
- Verify correct audit events.

F4 (P1) Rollback while timed progression is pending
- If timed stepper exists, set a timed progression then rollback before the next step.
- Assert background worker does not re-apply candidate weights after rollback.

G. Audit History / Activity Timeline
G1 (P0) Activity timeline entries for create/update/pause/rollback
- Perform actions.
- Confirm timeline ordering, timestamps, and actor attribution.

G2 (P1) Diff view correctness
- For an update, ensure diff highlights changed weights/guardrails/schedule.
- Validate no sensitive prompt/request data is included.

H. Telemetry + Dashboards + Cardinality
H1 (P0) Per-variant tagging present
- Generate traffic with rollout active.
- Query metrics (or inspect dashboard panels) to confirm dimensions:
  - route
  - rollout_id (if applicable)
  - variant (baseline/candidate)
  - model_version
- Confirm labels match naming conventions and aren’t exploding cardinality.

H2 (P1) Cardinality controls under multi-route load
- Create rollouts on both chat-completions-consoleqa and embeddings-consoleqa.
- Generate load.
- Assert telemetry pipeline remains healthy (no drop / backpressure alerts).
- Check sampling behavior is documented/visible if applied.

H3 (P2) Customer-like edge: high tenant/route counts
- Not feasible in shared staging today; log as follow-up if we can simulate with synthetic tenants.

I. Migration / Backward Compatibility (Beta -> GA)
I1 (P1) Existing beta rollout appears in GA UI
- Seed one “beta schema” rollout (if staging supports).
- Open Console; ensure it renders and indicates any migration.
- Edit and save; confirm upgraded to v2.

I2 (P1) API read compatibility
- Ensure older fields still readable (if contract requires) and no 500s.

J. Resilience / Failure Injection
J1 (P0) Control-plane evaluation degraded
- Induce control-plane partial outage (rate-limit policy eval endpoint or disable one replica).
- Validate:
  - UI handles errors gracefully
  - existing routing continues with last-known-good policy
  - alerts fire per SLO settings (informational in staging)

J2 (P1) Telemetry ingestion degraded
- Disable telemetry sink in staging (if safe).
- Ensure rollout creation/routing still works.
- UI should show “metrics unavailable” rather than misleading zeros.

J3 (P1) Region partial outage during rollout
- Simulate one region returning elevated 5xx.
- Confirm compare view doesn’t misattribute baseline vs candidate.

K. Regression Coverage (What we must not break)
Console
- Wizard: form validation, unsaved changes modal, back/next navigation, accessibility basics (tab order, labeled inputs).
- Preview effective routing: always matches what data plane uses (no stale preview or layer mismatch).
- Timeline: loads fast, paginates, handles empty/error states.

Control plane
- Deterministic policy evaluation given same inputs.
- Version monotonicity + propagation retries.
- Idempotent update endpoints.

Data plane
- Split correctness (random vs sticky).
- Streaming pin + retry semantics.
- No mixed-variant output.

Telemetry
- Variant labels present and stable.
- No unbounded label dimensions.

Audit
- Events on every action with actor, before/after, and retention/export compatibility.

Acceptance Criteria (QA signoff)
P0
- All P0 scenarios pass in staging twice:
  1) clean environment run
  2) after toggling feature flag off/on and re-running (catches caching/state assumptions)
- No P0 scenario requires manual DB edits or engineer intervention.
- Documented run commands + seed data procedure.

P1
- At least 80% of P1 pass; remaining have explicit risk + mitigation and an owner.

Reporting
- For each run: capture
  - rollout_id(s)
  - policy version(s)
  - start/end timestamps
  - region propagation times
  - links to dashboards/screenshots
  - any anomalies with request IDs

Open Questions / TODO
1) Exact guardrail enforcement rules in UI validation (what thresholds are mandatory at what candidate %?) — need final from Product (Marissa/Paula) + Zachary.
2) Do we support auto-pause / auto-rollback in GA or only alerting? Impacts E2 tests E2/F flows.
3) Best method to query per-variant metrics in staging programmatically (API endpoint vs dashboard export) — Logan/Nadia.
4) How to simulate candidate-only failure without impacting shared staging tenants — propose dedicated canary backend or fault injection header.
5) Confirm stickiness key precedence (session id vs request id vs user-provided header) — Mina/Ravi.

Appendix: Quick smoke checklist (manual, <15 minutes)
- Create rollout 95/5 with defaults
- Confirm preview shows 95/5
- Generate 100 requests; verify some candidate hits
- Pause; verify candidate stops
- Rollback; verify baseline 100%
- Confirm audit timeline has 4 actions

Change log
- 2024-10-03: Initial draft created (Leila)
- 2024-10-18: Added streaming semantics + retry stability cases (sync w/ Emily)
- 2024-11-12: Expanded propagation/staleness tests and telemetry cardinality checks (notes from SRE/Telemetry reviews)
